title: Not as Soft as Other Microfiber Sheets
text: Not as Soft as Other Microfiber Sheets. First let me start by saying that I am a fan of microfiber sheets. Of course I love expensive high thread count cotton sheets, but in recent years I just haven't been able to justify spending that amount of money on them, so for the last 3 or 4 years I have been using microfiber sets. In general, microfiber sheets are soft (not quite as soft as the high thread count cotton) and long lasting (definitely don't become threadbare like the cotton ones). Now let me focus on these sheets. On the softness, they are soft, but I expected softer. I've had some microfiber sets that are super soft and these are not. They fit well on my Sleep Number mattress/bed. They easily go over all of the corners without coming up. The biggest issue that I have with these sheets is that the stripes go horizontally on the top sheet. The picture has the stripes going vertically, but because of the finished edge on the top sheet, the only way it goes is horizontally which is strange, but also frustrating. This may just be a manufacturing error and not representative of all of their striped sheet sets. I will use these because they are okay, but I would probably not repurchase these particular sheets.
